rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Writing user input directly to an HTTP response allows for a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Writing incompletely sanitized values to HTML attribute strings can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Use of GET Request Method With Sensitive Query Strings
rules.description: Placing sensitive data in a GET request increases the risk of the data being exposed to an attacker.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie with Improper SameSite Attribute
rules.description: Sensitive cookies where the SameSite attribute is set to "None" can in some cases allow for Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
rules.description: External links that open in a new tab or window but do not specify link type 'noopener' or 'noreferrer' are a potential security risk.
A restricted route, URL, script, or file can be requested directly without required authorization.

rules.cwe_name: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')
rules.description: Server-side URL redirection based on unvalidated user input may cause redirection to malicious web sites.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
